Hero.label: MOVISTRATO / 001
Hero.abstract: Movistrato is a software research and development company focused on human learning.

Manifesto.title: Software shouldn't force everyone down <accent>the same path.</accent>
Manifesto.body: We believe in software that uses context, interaction, and intentional engineering to create experiences capable of becoming more relevant over time.
Manifesto.label: THESIS / 001

details.item1_body: Interfaces that react to the user's fluency. The system adjusts its complexity based on the human learning curve, ensuring it is never too basic nor too overwhelming.
details.item2_body: A single experience across all devices. Seamless transitions between web, mobile, and desktop, maintaining strict context in fractions of a second.
details.item3_body: Optimized architecture and pristine rendering. Fewer abstractions, less latency. We build computing engines to run natively on each operating system.

Manifesto.method_body: We don't build templates. We analyze how humans absorb information and design visual algorithms that respond to that pattern. Every millisecond of animation, every pixel of typography, and every data architecture decision serves a single purpose: to make technology invisible.

Product.label: PRODUCT / 01
Product.name: FARO
Product.description: A language learning platform centered around context, continuity, and adaptation.

features.f1_body: The heart of FARO. A deterministic algorithm that analyzes retained vocabulary and reconstructs study sessions in real-time. Nothing is random.
features.f2_body: Built from scratch for Windows and Android, avoiding sluggish web-wrappers. FARO utilizes native system APIs to guarantee the famous 120 frames per second.
features.f3_body: An interface that grows with you. As your level increases, visual support elements disappear, focusing you on the raw challenge.

Engineering.label: ENGINEERING / CORE
Engineering.title: <accent>Architecture</accent> before complexity.
Engineering.description: Great engineering means making complexity disappear. We build on solid, deliberate foundations—prioritizing reliability, performance, and software prepared to evolve.
Engineering.description2: Every line of code serves a purpose. We reject unnecessary abstractions, favoring explicit contracts and predictable data flows across the entire stack.
Engineering.description3: Built to last, not just to launch. Our architecture is designed to absorb future complexity without degrading performance or developer experience.
Engineering.pillar1_desc: Strict component boundaries and unambiguous data contracts. We avoid abstract layers that obscure the underlying architecture.
Engineering.pillar2_desc: Predictable data flow without unmanaged side-effects. Every state change is explicit, traceable, and fully controlled.
Engineering.pillar3_desc: Maximum output, minimum overhead. We write code that respects the hardware it runs on, eliminating unnecessary runtime costs.

AdaptiveSystem.label: SYSTEM / IN DEVELOPMENT
AdaptiveSystem.title: <software>Software</software> should shape itself to you.
AdaptiveSystem.description: An adaptive system learns from every interaction, using context to adjust complexity and progression without manual intervention.

Platforms.label: PLATFORMS / CONTINUITY
Platforms.title: The experience <highlight>follows</highlight> the person.
Platforms.description: We believe software should not be confined to a <highlight>single device</highlight>. FARO is designed to exist seamlessly across the platforms you use, <underline>maintaining context</underline> and progressing with you.
Platforms.feature1_desc: No web wrappers. Built specifically for each OS to ensure 120fps performance and minimal battery impact.
Platforms.feature2_desc: Your context moves with you. Resume exactly where you left off on any device with sub-10ms synchronization.
Platforms.feature3_desc: FARO runs locally. Full access to the contextual engine even when completely disconnected from the network.

Company.label: 07 / COMPANY
Company.description: Movistrato is a software company built to develop digital products with technical rigor and longevity. FARO is our first product — and the starting point for everything we want to build.

name.intro: The name did not begin with a definition. The company gave it one.

strato.label: 02 / STRUCTURE
strato.text: The layers and foundations on which software is built.

name.transition: THE SAME IDEA CONTINUES IN THE MARK.

0.title: 00. Origins
0.text: Movistrato's identity is born from the same place as the company: Portugal. Our emblem is a contemporary interpretation of Portuguese heraldic tradition. The shield and the five quinas establish a subtle connection to our origins, not as a reproduction of national symbols, but as a tribute reinterpreted through the language that defines us: engineering and technology.

1.title: 01. The Quinas
1.text: The five quinas represent five principles upon which we want to build Movistrato: <blue>Engineering</blue>, <gold>Ambition</gold>, <red>Sacrifice</red>, <stone>Integrity</stone>, and <emerald>Innovation</emerald>. Different values, united within the same system.

2.title: 02. Circuits
2.text: Running between them are lines inspired by electronic circuits. They represent the invisible connections behind technology — architecture, code, data, and systems working together to transform an idea into a product. Their symmetry translates the rigor and precision we seek to apply to software engineering.

3.title: 03. The Core
3.text: At the center, the very geometry of the emblem hides an 'M'. It wasn't placed as a conventional letter: it's part of the structure. A reference to Movistrato that reveals itself only to those who look closely.

4.title: 04. The Crown
4.text: Above the shield rises a geometric crown. For us, it doesn't represent status or wealth. It represents ambition — the will to constantly elevate what we build and to compete beyond the borders where we started.

5.title: 05. The System
5.text: Gold appears only in small points of the symbol. It is deliberately restrained: it represents energy, knowledge, creation, and the moments when an idea comes to life. Graphite conveys structure and precision; white space preserves clarity and simplicity. The result seeks to reflect Movistrato's own philosophy: complexity on the inside, simplicity on the outside.

6.title: 06. The Manifesto
6.text:
A Portuguese symbol without needing to show a flag.

A technological symbol without needing to write “software”.

A Movistrato symbol without needing to write its name.

We were born in Portugal. We build for the world.
